testCaseDescription: Validate successful LTE attach procedure for a single UE under excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: Single LTE cell active with no inter-cell interference.
UE placed at cell center with LTE RSRP within excellent range as per Clause 4.6.
All other cells powered off.
Test configuration parameters recorded.
testSteps: Configure test setup according to test configuration and activate serving LTE cell.
Place UE under excellent radio conditions (LTE RSRP as per Clause 4.6).
Start logs to capture call flow and signalling messages.
Power ON the UE to initiate LTE attach.
Wait for attach complete message indicating successful attach (3GPP TS 23.401 Clause 5.3.2.1).
Stop and save the logs.
expectedResults: Attach request and attach complete messages are successfully exchanged.
UE is attached to the correct LTE cell (verify PCI, Global eNB ID, ARFCN).
Attach success rate for this iteration is 100%.
Attach latency is recorded.
postconditions: UE remains attached to LTE cell until detached.
verificationMethods: Analyze UE logs or application data to confirm attach success and correct cell attachment.
Parse captured signalling logs for attach request and complete messages.
Measure attach latency from logs.

testCaseDescription: Validate successful LTE detach procedure for a single UE under excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: UE is successfully attached to LTE cell.
Test configuration parameters recorded.
testSteps: Start logs to capture call flow and signalling messages.
Power OFF the UE to initiate LTE detach (3GPP TS 23.401 Clause 5.3.8.2.1 UE-initiated Detach).
Wait for detach accept and signalling connection release messages.
Stop and save the logs.
expectedResults: Detach request and detach accept messages are successfully exchanged.
Signalling connection release messages (UE context release and RRC connection release) are observed.
Detach success rate for this iteration is 100%.
postconditions: UE is detached from the LTE cell.
verificationMethods: Analyze captured signalling logs to confirm UE-initiated detach procedure completion.
Verify release of UE context and RRC connection.

testCaseDescription: Validate 10 consecutive successful LTE attach and detach procedures for a single UE with KPI measurement.
preconditions: Single LTE cell active with no inter-cell interference.
UE placed at cell center with LTE RSRP within excellent range.
All other cells powered off.
Test configuration parameters recorded.
testSteps: For iteration 1 to 10:
- Start logs to capture call flow and signalling messages.
- Power ON the UE to initiate LTE attach.
- Wait for successful attach confirmation.
- Power OFF the UE to initiate LTE detach.
- Wait for successful detach confirmation.
- Stop and save the logs.
Measure and record attach success rate, detach success rate, and attach latency for each iteration.
expectedResults: Each attach and detach procedure completes successfully for all 10 iterations with 100% success rate.
Attach latency is measured for each iteration and minimum, average, maximum latency values are recorded.
UE is attached to the correct LTE cell during attach.
Signalling connection release is validated during detach.
postconditions: Test logs captured for all iterations are saved for reference.
KPI tables 5-2 and 5-3 are populated with results.
verificationMethods: Analyze logs for attach and detach message flows per iteration.
Calculate KPIs (attach success rate, detach success rate, attach latency).
Validate cell identity parameters in UE logs.

testCaseDescription: Validate successful 5G NSA attach procedure including secondary node addition for a single UE under excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: Single 5G NSA cell active with no inter-cell interference.
UE placed at cell center with 5G SS-RSRP within excellent range as per Clause 4.6.
All other cells powered off.
Test configuration parameters recorded.
testSteps: Configure test setup according to test configuration and activate serving 5G NSA cell.
Place UE under excellent radio conditions (5G SS-RSRP as per Clause 4.6).
Start logs to capture call flow and signalling messages.
Power ON the UE to initiate 5G NSA attach (3GPP TS 23.401 Clause 5.3.2.1 and 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.2.1).
Wait for attach complete and secondary node addition confirmation messages.
Stop and save the logs.
expectedResults: Attach request and attach complete messages are successfully exchanged.
Secondary node addition (SgNB addition request and SgNB reconfiguration complete) messages are validated.
UE is attached to correct LTE and 5G cells (verify PCI, Global eNB ID/ gNB, ARFCN/NR-ARFCN).
Attach success rate and secondary node addition success rate for this iteration is 100%.
postconditions: UE remains attached to 5G NSA cell until detached.
verificationMethods: Analyze UE logs or application data to confirm attach success and secondary node addition.
Parse captured signalling logs for attach and secondary node addition messages.

testCaseDescription: Validate successful 5G NSA detach procedure including secondary node release for a single UE under excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: UE is successfully attached to 5G NSA cell with secondary node added.
Test configuration parameters recorded.
testSteps: Start logs to capture call flow and signalling messages.
Power OFF the UE to initiate 5G NSA detach (3GPP TS 23.401 Clause 5.3.8.2.1 and 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.4.1).
Wait for detach accept and secondary node release confirmation messages.
Stop and save the logs.
expectedResults: Detach request and detach accept messages are successfully exchanged.
Secondary node release procedure messages (SgNB Release Request, SgNB Release Request Acknowledge, and RRC Connection Reconfiguration) are validated.
Signalling connection release messages (UE context release and RRC connection release) are observed.
Detach success rate for this iteration is 100%.
Secondary node is released successfully.
postconditions: UE is detached from the 5G NSA cell and secondary node is released.
verificationMethods: Analyze captured signalling logs to confirm UE-initiated detach and secondary node release procedures.
Verify release of UE context, RRC connection, and secondary node resources.

UE placed at cell center with 5G SS-RSRP within excellent range.

testSteps: For iteration 1 to 10:

expectedResults: Each attach, secondary node addition, detach, and secondary node release procedure completes successfully for all 10 iterations with 100% success rate.

Signalling connection and secondary node releases are validated during detach.
postconditions: Test logs captured for all iterations are saved for reference.
KPI tables 5-2 are populated with results.

testCaseDescription: Validate system behavior when UE fails to attach after power ON due to invalid or corrupted attach request.
preconditions: Test setup configured with single LTE or 5G NSA cell.
UE is configured to send invalid attach request (e.g., malformed message or wrong credentials).
testSteps: Start logs to capture call flow and signalling messages.
Power ON the UE with invalid attach request.
Wait for attach failure indication or timeout.
Stop and save the logs.
expectedResults: Attach request is rejected by network.
Attach procedure fails with appropriate error cause.
Attach success rate is 0% for this iteration.
System logs reflect attach failure reason.
postconditions: UE remains detached.
System recovers gracefully without crashes.
verificationMethods: Analyze signalling logs for attach failure messages and error causes.
Verify no UE context is created at network.
Check system stability and error handling.

testCaseDescription: Validate system behavior when detach request fails or no detach accept is received upon UE power OFF.
preconditions: UE is successfully attached to LTE or 5G NSA cell.
Network is configured to simulate detach accept message loss or rejection.
testSteps: Start logs to capture call flow and signalling messages.
Power OFF the UE to initiate detach.
Simulate network failure to send detach accept or reject detach request.
Wait for timeout or failure indication.
Stop and save the logs.
expectedResults: Detach procedure fails or times out.
UE context may remain active in network.
System logs indicate detach failure or timeout.
Detach success rate is 0% for this iteration.
postconditions: UE remains logically attached or system cleans up context after timeout.
System recovers gracefully.
verificationMethods: Analyze signalling logs for missing detach accept or error messages.
Verify UE context state in network.
Check system stability and recovery.

testCaseDescription: Validate attach and detach procedures at the boundary of excellent radio conditions defined by LTE RSRP or 5G SS-RSRP minimum coupling loss.
preconditions: Test setup with adjustable attenuator or UE emulator to set radio conditions.
UE placed under radio conditions at the minimum threshold of excellent RSRP as per Clause 4.6.
testSteps: Configure radio conditions to achieve RSRP exactly at minimum excellent threshold.
Start logs to capture call flow and signalling messages.
Power ON the UE to initiate attach.
Wait for successful attach or failure indication.
Power OFF the UE to initiate detach.
Wait for successful detach or failure indication.
Stop and save the logs.
expectedResults: Attach and detach succeed if conditions are within acceptable range.
KPIs are recorded and compared with expected targets.
If attach or detach fails, failure reason is documented.
postconditions: Test logs saved for analysis.
verificationMethods: Analyze logs for attach/detach success or failure at boundary conditions.
Measure KPIs and compare with expected targets.

testCaseDescription: Evaluate system performance and stability during repeated attach and detach procedures beyond 10 iterations under excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: Single LTE or 5G NSA cell active.
UE placed under excellent radio conditions.
Test configuration parameters recorded.
testSteps: Configure test setup and activate serving cell.
Place UE under excellent radio conditions.
Start logs to capture call flow and signalling messages.
Repeat attach and detach cycle for 100 iterations:
- Power ON the UE to initiate attach.
- Wait for successful attach confirmation.
- Power OFF the UE to initiate detach.
- Wait for successful detach confirmation.
- Record KPIs for each iteration.
Stop and save the logs.
expectedResults: System maintains 100% attach and detach success rate over 100 iterations.
Attach latency remains within acceptable range without degradation.
No resource leaks or system crashes observed.
KPIs are stable and within target thresholds.
postconditions: Test logs captured for all iterations are saved.
Resource utilization and system logs verified for stability.
verificationMethods: Analyze logs for success rates and latency trends across iterations.
Monitor system resource usage and error logs.

testCaseDescription: Validate access control mechanisms reject unauthorized UE during attach procedure.

Wait for network to reject attach due to access control rules.
Stop and save the logs.
expectedResults: Attach request is rejected with appropriate access control cause.
UE remains detached and cannot access network resources.
postconditions: Access control policies enforced properly.
verificationMethods: Analyze signalling logs for access control rejection.
Verify UE state remains detached.

testCaseDescription: Validate MN initiated secondary node release procedure including SgNB Release Request and UE SCG configuration release.
preconditions: UE is attached to 5G NSA cell with secondary node active.
Network supports MN initiated secondary node release.
testSteps: Start logs to capture signalling messages.
Trigger MN initiated secondary node release by sending SgNB Release Request from MN to SN.
Wait for SgNB Release Request Acknowledge from SN.
Observe RRCConnectionReconfiguration message towards UE to release SCG configuration.
Verify SN sends SN Status Transfer and Secondary RAT Data Usage Report messages.
Verify UE Context Release message received by SN.
Stop and save the logs.
expectedResults: Secondary node release procedure completes successfully.
UE releases SCG configuration.
SN releases radio and control plane resources.
Data forwarding and reporting messages are correctly exchanged.
postconditions: Secondary node is released and resources freed.
UE continues communication via MN only.
verificationMethods: Analyze signalling logs for message flow per Figure 10.4.1-1.
Verify correct sequence and content of messages.
Confirm UE SCG configuration release.

testCaseDescription: Validate SN initiated secondary node release procedure including SgNB Release Required and UE SCG configuration release.
preconditions: UE is attached to 5G NSA cell with secondary node active.
Network supports SN initiated secondary node release.
testSteps: Start logs to capture signalling messages.
Trigger SN initiated secondary node release by sending SgNB Release Required from SN to MN.
Wait for SgNB Release Confirm from MN to SN with data forwarding addresses.
Observe RRCConnectionReconfiguration message towards UE to release SCG configuration.
Verify SN sends SN Status Transfer and Secondary RAT Data Usage Report messages.
Verify UE Context Release message received by SN.
Stop and save the logs.
expectedResults: Secondary node release procedure completes successfully.
UE releases SCG configuration.
SN releases radio and control plane resources.
Data forwarding and reporting messages are correctly exchanged.
postconditions: Secondary node is released and resources freed.
UE continues communication via MN only.
verificationMethods: Analyze signalling logs for message flow per Figure 10.4.1-2.
Verify correct sequence and content of messages.
Confirm UE SCG configuration release.
